## What is verified, and where

- **The numerical core** (`core/`, Rust compiled to WebAssembly) has a
  validation suite that `cargo test --release` runs on every push. Every
  claim in the text that rests on one of its tests carries a ✓ badge
  linking to the test.
- **The API documentation** of the core is published with the report at
  [api/](../api/report_core/index.html); the ⟨name⟩ marks in the text link
  to the function that evaluates the equation next to them.
- **Citations** are verified against the field's literature index before
  they enter the bibliography.

## How to cite

The repository carries a `CITATION.cff`; GitHub shows it as "Cite this
repository". Until a DOI is minted, cite the repository and the commit above.

## Sharing a view of the laboratory

Every state of the laboratory is encoded in the address bar (the part after
`#`), so copying the URL shares the exact experiment; the *copy link* button
does this. Plots download as SVG or CSV from their toolbars.

## Annotating and discussing

Pages carry the Hypothesis sidebar: select any passage to annotate it.
Corrections are welcome as issues; every page has an *Edit this page* link.
